checks.check: at least 2 expired Check runs exist
another session locks a Finding of Check 129 and the run row of Check 130
WARN 'Report purge kept Check run 130: its deletion failed (<cause>).' before the closing line
the cause is the deletion's own database failure (the lock wait timed out), not the rollback's
no row content appears in the purge log
Check 130 still stored with all its records
